You are cordially invited to the inaugural SwedenChina Award Ceremony,
hosted by Barbro's Best and Brightest and PwC
(Please see formal invitation attached as PDF)
The Sweden-China Award is a commitment to providing talented young female professionals with a
platform for bridging business opportunities between Sweden and one of the most important economies
today, China. The Sweden-China Award gives the winner an extraordinary chance to establish a career
spanning both markets.
The Winner
The inaugural Award winner - the Sweden-China Professional of the Year - is an exceptionally talented
young woman, Feifei Tian. With an LL.M. from Uppsala University and a B.Sc. from Stockholm School of
Economics, her previous work experience ranges from management consulting in Sweden, Europe and
Africa to blogging for Svenska Dagbladet in China. Feifei's global mindset, problem-solving capabilities and
Mandarin language skills makes her uniquely suited for this cross-cultural role.
The Prize
As a part of The Sweden-China Award, the winner receives a cross-functional and tailor-made position
with PwC bridging business opportunities between Stockholm and Shanghai. Additionally, as a BBB
member with access to BBB Friends - a select network of 600 members in the Swedish and international
business society - she will expand the network's geographical footprint to China.
